primary_surface.outer_zip_reason: dynamic packaging observed; scientific identity is the immutable inner XML payload bytes

instrument_identity.scope: B3 listed mini futures whose ticker begins WIN or WDO

dedupe.duplicate_rule: same trade_date + ticker_symbol + semantically identical PriceReport row within the same qualified payload is one observation
dedupe.cross_leaf_duplicate_rule: identical row content may be deduplicated only after exact content comparison; conflicting rows may not be averaged or selected by economics

session_and_timezone.feature_date_semantics: all fields from session t are treated as available only after the session-t PriceReport publication surface is available
session_and_timezone.earliest_signal_use: session t fields may first affect a decision for session t+1 or later

publication_timing_and_pit.conservative_pit_rule: one-session lag minimum for all admitted PriceReport fields
fields_allowed: own-market volume/quantity/trade-count fields physically present in the qualified report
own-market open-interest fields physically present in the qualified report
fields_forbidden_without_separate_revisi: fields whose historical revision or publication semantics cannot be established
derived values reconstructed from later data
publication_timing_and_pit.revisions: if B3 historical payload bytes differ across repeated qualification captures, affected date/report must fail closed until the revision is explicitly classified; no silent latest-vintage substitution

evidence.known_gap_operator_disposition: 2021-06-10 accepted as one frozen missing observation out of 1245 official sessions
